title: A Choir for the House
author: Felix Thackeray
blurb: Xanthe Dunmore, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
